risk_note: F1-08at (FU-ADMIN-UNKNOWN-ON-RELOGIN, D10-2075). apps/admin only (pages/withdrawals, pages/adjustments, components/unknown-marker, texts). On entering a result-unknown state (batch manual paid, detail-page manual paid / execute payout, adjustment create / reverse / approve / reject / write-off) the console keeps one sessionStorage item keyed by page and admin_id whose whole value is {page, unknown: true, at}; no ids, amounts, keys or bodies. After re-login the page shows a fixed prompt with one real close button; resolved results clear only the instance's own marker. No new write requests, no automatic resend, request bodies and idempotency handling unchanged.
